description: This file contains SQL schema migrations and policies for a Supabase database, defining tables, functions, triggers, policies, and permissions related to user profiles, documents, access controls, versioning, views, and storage policies for a document management platform.

methods.name: public.set_updated_at
methods.description: Sets the updated_at timestamp to current time before updates on profiles and documents.

methods.name: public.is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the 'admin' role in profiles.

methods.name: public.increment_document_view_count
methods.description: Increments the view count for a document when a new view is recorded.
